explanation.text: Take the 40 day challenge! It is simple: print the card and put it someplace where you'll see it every day, and read it anytime you can, at least once a day. Forty days is not a test. Nothing here is earned — God made you His child when you asked Him to take you to His home. The forty days are simply forty days of reading the card and asking God what He wants you to do with it: “Lord Jesus, what do You want me to do with this card? Help me to do it.” Each day there is a new verse for the day. Read the verse. Use the rules. If you miss a day, there is nothing to make up — start again from the day you last read it. For example: you read it every day for 4 days and forgot for 2 days — just start reading again from day 5 and keep reading until you finish the 40 days. On the fortieth day nothing ends: ask God if He wants you to keep reading it every day.
